summary: Boaz goes to gate where elders sit, says to near kinsman who has right to redeem: Naomi selling parcel of land of Elimelech, buy it before those sitting, if you will redeem redeem, if not tell me. Kinsman says I will redeem. Boaz says day you buy field from Naomi you must also buy Ruth Moabite widow of dead to raise up name of dead on inheritance. Kinsman says I cannot lest I mar my own inheritance, you redeem. Custom sandal drawn off. Boaz says you are witnesses today I have bought all Elimelech's and Ruth to be my wife to raise up name of dead not cut off. People say witness, Yahweh make woman like Rachel and Leah who built house of Israel, may you do worthily in Ephrathah, be famous in Bethlehem. So Boaz takes Ruth wife, Yahweh gives her conception, bears son Obed, women say blessed be Yahweh who has not left you without kinsman, may his name famous in Israel, restorer of life nourisher in old age, for your daughter-in-law who loves you better than seven sons has borne him. Naomi takes child lays in bosom becomes nurse. Women name Obed — servant — he is father of Jesse father of David. Genealogy Perez to David.
whyItMatters: Redemption completed — Boaz as goel kinsman-redeemer buys field and marries Ruth to preserve name of dead, child Obed restores Naomi's emptiness, becomes grandfather of David and ancestor of Jesus. Shows hesed leading to fullness.

keyVerses.text: The near kinsman said, “I can’t redeem it for myself, lest I endanger my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption for yourself; for I can’t redeem it.”
keyVerses.why: Near kinsman declines because Ruth Moabite would mar inheritance — legal and ethnic obstacle.

keyVerses.text: The women said to Naomi, “Blessed be Yahweh, who has not left you today without a near kinsman. Let his name be famous in Israel.
keyVerses.why: Women's blessing inverts Naomi's Mara bitterness — restorer, better than seven sons.

keyVerses.text: The women, her neighbors, gave him a name, saying, “A son is born to Naomi”. They named him Obed. He is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
keyVerses.why: Obed = servant, grandfather of David, ancestor of Jesus.

questions.question: What is kinsman-redeemer goel and why near kinsman says I cannot lest mar my inheritance?
questions.answer: Goel is close relative who redeems family land to keep in family, and marries widow to raise name of dead (levirate via redeemer). Near kinsman willing to buy land (good investment) but when learns must also marry Ruth Moabite widow, says cannot lest mar my own inheritance. Why? Possibly financial — land plus child to support, child's inheritance would go to dead's line not his, dividing; or ethnic — Deuteronomy forbids Moabite entering assembly; marrying Moabite could taint. Boaz willing where other not — shows hesed over calculation.

questions.question: What does drawing off sandal mean?
questions.answer: Custom in Israel concerning redeeming and exchanging: man drew off sandal gave to other, this was manner of attestation. Sandal represents ownership and right to walk on land — removing and giving transfers right. Like deed. Becomes symbolic: Boaz gets sandal, right to redeem. Deuteronomy 25:9 has widow pull sandal off reluctant kinsman and spit — shaming. Here done honorably as legal act.

questions.question: Why do people say 'Yahweh make woman like Rachel and Leah who built house of Israel'?
questions.answer: Rachel and Leah are matriarchs who built house of Israel — twelve sons. Blessing says may Ruth who is Moabite outsider be like them, building house. Also 'do worthily in Ephrathah be famous in Bethlehem' — Ephrathah is Bethlehem region. Prayer that Boaz be worthy (chayil same root as eshet chayil woman of valor) and famous — his worthiness shown in redemption. Both Rachel Leah and Boaz Ruth as outsiders/insiders become builders of Israel.

questions.question: How does child Obed restore Naomi's emptiness from chapter 1?
questions.answer: Chapter 1 ends empty: I went out full, Yahweh brought me home empty, call me Mara bitter. Beginning barley harvest. Chapter 4 ends full: women say blessed be Yahweh who has not left you without kinsman (goel), may name famous, he shall be restorer of your life and nourisher of old age, for daughter-in-law who loves you better than seven sons has borne him. Naomi takes child in bosom becomes nurse. Empty to full, bitter to sweet, famine to harvest to birth — reversal complete. Obed = servant, serves as restorer. Genealogy to David shows personal story part of larger messianic line.

glossary.def: Close relative who redeems land and marries widow to preserve name of dead.
Legal attestation — transferring right to walk on land, deed.
Seven = completeness — Ruth's loyalty surpasses ideal number of sons.
